rules.label: Financial Assistance for Uninsured patients (<=400% FPL)
rules.quote: If you are an Uninsured patient, you will qualify for BH Financial Assistance (1) if you have an annual household income and household size that is equal to or less than 400% of the Federal Poverty Level and lack other assets to pay the Hospital’s full charges

rules.label: Discounted care for Uninsured patients not qualifying for FAP
rules.quote: If you are an Uninsured patient, you may qualify for a discounted rate if you do not meet the qualifications for the Financial Assistance Program based on Federal Poverty Level guidelines. Qualification for the discounted care means, you will be charged 1.25 x AGB (Amounts Generally Billed)

rules.label: Financial Assistance for Underinsured/Balance After Insurance
rules.quote: If you are an Underinsured patient, you may qualify for BH Financial Assistance for Underinsured/Balance After Insurance discount. You will need to apply for consideration and meet both Hospital bill balance requirements stated in the Financial Assistance Policy and Federal Poverty Level guidelines.

notes: Policy requires application for Medicaid/AHCCCS and cooperation in the application process for uninsured patients seeking financial assistance.
Policy states that patients qualifying for financial assistance will in no case be charged more than Amounts Generally Billed (AGB) for emergency services or other medically necessary services.
Policy states that patients will never be required to make advance payment or other payment arrangements to receive emergency services.
For non-emergent services, patients will be required in most situations to make a substantial advance deposit or other payment arrangements based upon an estimate of the Amounts Generally Billed.

Policy includes a lien recovery provision: any third-party funding received or eligible to receive pursuant to Arizona’s health care lien statute may be considered and recovered by Banner Health to offset the financial assistance discount provided.
Policy does not specify exact timing for application submission, ECA restrictions, or first statement issuance beyond general references to cooperation and process.
Policy does not define specific payment plan terms (maximum percentage of monthly income, maximum months, minimum monthly payment).
